name: DurableStore
lead: Shared durable stores. Calls yield; pcall catches structured errors such as {err = "conflict", version = 3}. One store per experience.

functions.name: get
functions.description: Returns a fact's value and its version; version 0 means absent.

functions.name: set
functions.signature: durableStore:set(key: string, value: any, if_version: number, lease: number ?) → number
functions.description: Writes a fact if its version is still `if_version`, and returns the new version. A mismatch errors with {err = "conflict"}.

functions.name: delete
functions.signature: durableStore:delete(key: string, if_version: number, lease: number ?)
functions.description: Removes a fact if its version is still `if_version`.

functions.name: increment
functions.description: Adds `by` to a number atomically, starting at zero, and returns the result. Never retry it blindly after a timeout.

functions.name: list
functions.signature: durableStore:list(prefix: string ?, cursor: string ?, limit: number ?) → ({ string }, string ?)
functions.description: Returns fact keys with this prefix and the cursor for the next page, or nil at the end.

functions.name: blob_get
functions.description: Returns one player's binary blob, or nil, and its version; `owner` is the player's uuid.

functions.name: blob_put
functions.signature: durableStore:blob_put(owner: string, key: string, bytes: string, if_version: number, lease: number ?) → number
functions.description: Writes a player's binary blob if its version is still `if_version`, and returns the new version. At most 32 MiB.

functions.name: blob_delete
functions.signature: durableStore:blob_delete(owner: string, key: string, if_version: number, lease: number ?)
functions.description: Deletes a player's blob if its version is still `if_version`.
